children: U.S. President Donald Trump backed continued artificial intelligence investment during an unexpected phone call with Nvidia
CEO Jensen Huang at the All-In Summit in Los Angeles on Monday, as debate over AI risks and regulation continues, according to a Monday report.

Huang placed Trump on speakerphone during the event, where the president dismissed concerns that AI could threaten society. Trump also praised data centers and described artificial intelligence as a larger development than the internet.

Trump said the United States must maintain its lead over China in AI. He also argued that criticism of the sector could benefit China, while saying existing regulatory and criminal authorities give Washington tools to address problems involving AI companies.

Huang backed the president's position during the discussion. He also called for AI safety concerns to receive attention, praising former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon after his resignation over those issues.

The comments come amid broader debate involving OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Elon Musk over safeguards and the pace of AI development. Trump has opposed calls for tighter restrictions, saying heavier oversight could undermine U.S. competitiveness.

title: Trump Just Sent a Stark Warning to AI Critics With Nvidia CEO
